2. Primary method = highest precedence among available methods.

   Available methods: MC1, MC8, MC9
   - MC8 has higher precedence than MC9
   - MC9 has higher precedence than MC1

   Primary is MC8, not MC6. So witnesses_required = false.

5. documented_only = true if and only if every available method is MC0 or MC1.
   Available methods are MC1, MC8, MC9. Not all are MC0 or MC1. So documented_only = false.
